question: Does a lineage's developmentally structured anthocyanin-pathway gene-expression profile retain ancestry within a shared visible flower-colour state?
unit: one independently sampled, source-labelled taxon/tip, never individual gene, developmental stage, qPCR technical replicate, or independent flower-colour morph of the same taxon

frame.tree_admission: require original 2016 observed-tip branch-length tree, or a separately designated 2024 sequenced-only sensitivity; nonsequenced phylogenetic imputations not admitted
frame.aliases: explicit voucher/name source crosswalk, do not use automated fuzzy/orthographic string substitutions

molecular_features.primary_feature_axis: 7 pathway genes × 3 development stages =21 fixed developmentally ordered features per independently matched tip
molecular_features.fold_expression: use original source Fold Change 2^-ΔΔCt numeric values; require strictly positive and finite and comparable calibration across taxa, otherwise HOLD
molecular_features.transform: log2 of source fold-change, then per feature equal-weight population zscore among admitted tips
molecular_features.zero_variance_rule: do not silently select response axes; if any fixed 21 feature has zero variance, flag structural HOLD and separately report invariant component
molecular_features.stage_axis_homology: published juvenile/intermediate/adult categories are relative developmental states, not directly matched chronological times; do not infer absolute heterochrony or use developmental stages as tips

primary_test.pair_universe: unordered pairs of distinct non-polymorphic sequenced taxa carrying exactly identical visible red/pink/white/yellow Table 2 codes; same-color pair count determined after prospective tip join
primary_test.predictor: patristic distance from originally chosen nonimputed branch-length source tree
primary_test.outcome: equal-weight RMS Euclidean distance in all 21 stage-by-gene fixed standardized log2 fold-change features
primary_test.statistic: Spearman rho across within-visible-color unordered pairs (dependent pair observations)
primary_test.null: 9,999 independent permutations of intact 21-coordinate species expression vectors within the fixed visible-color class, preserving stage covariance, with observed phylogeny, tip labels, and color classes unchanged
primary_test.pass_rule: positive observed-minus-null-mean Spearman rho AND p<=0.05 AND source support gates passed
primary_test.not_supported_rule: if support gates passed and pass criterion not met, NOT_SUPPORTED for this estimand, no pooling or recoding
primary_test.structural_hold_rule: if required observed taxon, calibrated qPCR, biochemical-unit, or branch-length tree not admitted, HOLD not biological FAIL

secondary_descriptive.age_collapsed: within gene, mean log2 fold-change across the three stages, then standardize across admitted tips and recompute same-colour correlation; descriptive only, no new p value
secondary_descriptive.per_stage: three separate 7-gene stage contrasts descriptive only (no stage selected based on outcome)
secondary_descriptive.sensitivity: 2024 sequenced-only tree as explicitly independent source sensitivity after source and imputed-tip gate; never substituted silently
secondary_descriptive.biology: A positive result means developmental-expression conservation conditional on visible flower colour, NOT the Petunieae pigment-chemistry-identical estimand, independent causal mutation events, fitness selection, or absolute decay time.
